releases.displayName: BENEATH Gets a New Update Just in Time for Steam Scream Fest!

items.text: Deep underwater, nobody can hear you scream. Which is probably for the best.
BENEATH is joining Steam Scream Fest! Face unspeakable horrors, fight for survival and discover what lurks in the depths.
And we've got more than just a sale to share.

We've just released a new update for BENEATH, bringing performance improvements, fixes and a few quality-of-life additions to make your journey into the depths a little smoother. Well, as smooth as surviving an underwater nightmare can be.
Improved performance across the game.
Visual fixes, including issues with objects unexpectedly disappearing.
Weapon boxes added near workbenches, allowing you to switch between weapons you've previously discovered.
Turkish localisation fixes and improvements.
Improved computer screen interactions, with visual enhancements.
New prologue skip option, allowing you to jump straight into the action at Wikner Station.
Thank you to everyone who's played BENEATH and shared their feedback. We're continuing to listen and make improvements.
But the nightmare doesn't have to end there.

We've gathered some of our most terrifying games together for Steam Scream Fest. Whether you prefer psychological horror, supernatural mysteries or something with a little more firepower, there's plenty waiting for you.
And with discounts across our horror catalogue, now's a pretty good time to discover your next nightmare.

items.text: Hello everyone!
We hope that you're ready to be suitably spooked as we move into The Scary Month

We're cooking up an update at the moment that gives improved performance, fixes some visual effects and making some changes to weapon boxes and including the option to skip the initial prologue for those that want replayability without the exposition!
No set time for this to be live but expect to see some more information and a solid date within the next couple of weeks.
Until then, stay out of trouble - stay scary - and stay out the water!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43715895/7025103b0c735de62f16f09fa28e88b01f908758.jpg"]

In a FREE update to Beneath on Steam - you can now challenge yourselves to survive against a terror that never ends. The Final Stand is a brand new horde mode where you will be placed on one of 3 maps. With limited ammo and 3 a minute timer you will be forced to kill the horrors of the deep to increase your time limit and score. We've also dropped a few more fixes that we've been working on.
Each of the maps has a different layout and features different enemies, features and weapons.
Only one thing is certain, you WILL die, but how long you last and how high you make it on the online leaderboards? That's entirely down to you and your ability to fight the relentless hordes.
It's time to make your Final Stand.
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1593230/Beneath/"]
Hello everyone,

notes.title: A new patch is now live for Beneath - notes are as follows

items.text: Fixed the issue where firing immediately after switching to the KV-12 would cause the weapon to disappear.
Fixed the issue where Quinn's hand position would be incorrect if firing the KV-12 immediately after reloading.
Fixed the issue where pressing fire while facing a keypad would cause the gun to shake without shooting.
Fixed the issue where Quinn's stamina didn't recover from a very low level, after clicking on an audiolog.
Flashlight can now be turned on when sanity is low.
Fixed the issue where the active weapon would disappear when resuming a game where the crowbar was active prior.
Fixed the issue where handguns with suppressors couldn't destroy yellow gas bubbles.
Fixed several culling issues in different levels, where objects could be seen appearing or disappearing.
Fixed the issue where soldiers could enter a locked door in Shirazi station.
Fixed the scale of an oxygen machine in Ivavov.
Adjusted the difficulty of the Lost City's boss fight on 'Tourist Pass'.
Fixed the issue where the intro text to the Lost City displayed in English when language is set to Japanese.
Please update you game to the latest version, and as always we look forward to your feedback.

If there are any bugs or issues after updating - please let us know in the discussions, and if you left a review related to an issue that has been fixed (or you havent reviewed at all!) please consider letting folks know about the game!
We'll speak soon with more information on the upcoming retro mode!

releases.displayName: New Patch and Community Items Live

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43715895/79481d7561c30c23f7f1688a325dce2f4ae44e71.jpg"]
Hello everyone, hope you've enjoyed your week!
We have a few updates here for you covering a new patch, community items - and a compilation of some of our favourite moments we've seen from creators! Let's get to it!
Patch Notes

Starting off with the important stuff - a new patch is live! We've been looking through your reviews, bug reports and social discussions and addressing critical complaints that have been impacting your enjoyment the new patch is a bit meaty! Details below :
Completed difficulty now displayed per checkpoint within the Load Menu.
Removed the possibility to change difficulty during a game. which was triggering a flag and giving the Tourist Pass achievement only.
Resolved issue where negative ammo would be given for the AK.
AI tweaked so they now acknowledge when the player is hidden.
Removed door in the kitchen which was triggering some problems for some users.
Added more ammo/health in Lost City.
Added more ammo/health for Tourist Pass during the final battle in Lost City.
Skarg and Hybrids now have less health on Tourist Pass.
Fixed minor collision bugs.
Adjusted LOD levels in some meshes.
Re-encoded all videos with a new codec that will not trigger HDCP on some HDMI devices.
Resolved issues with difficulty achievements not popping. If you had this issue please complete the following fix:
Start a new game in the completed difficulty.
Reach the first checkpoint (Within the Submarine).
Return to the Main Menu and Load the very last checkpoint within game.
Kill the boss and complete the game.
Apologies for any inconvenience caused with this!
Need something to spend your Steam points on? We got you covered, community items and trading cards are live RIGHT NOW for the completionists out there, get a Cthulu in your digital pocket!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43715895/b34de89dc955f477dbf63fe6eb88b68b3b85b702.jpg"]

When we say we are always watching - we mean it! Thanks to everyone that has been making videos, streaming our sharing tiktoks of Beneath - as an indie team this organic hype from y'all on the ground level REALLY makes a difference - we've reached out to a group of some of our favourite moments we've seen in vods and livestreams and compiled them into a handy little 'Look at you go!' compilation - whether you've been slaying ancient evil - getting jumpscared or... rapping? We appreciate you all!

Thank you as always for your feedback, reviews - and discussions - we'll continue to smash out issues as we find them and keep you updated - so keep them coming (and if something in a review has been fixed by a patch - consider switching it over to positive if you're satisfied!)
Next week we'll be sharing the roadmap for the rest of this year, giving you an update on bugs and issues we're currently working on - and a sneak peak at some exciting updates coming in 2026.
See you soon!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43715895/0a85e79ed2065c69b4a646145dce27530c9fcb38.jpg"]

Hello everyone, just a quick heads up that since our first major patch earlier this week - we have finished a follow up patch that is now LIVE, and contains additional fixes, and one or two requests we've seen in reviews and socials.

notes.title: Here's a quick run down of the update content

items.text: Fixes to some animations.
Most keyboard keys, including numpad, home, insert, etc can be now binded.
Fixed issue where Headbob was interfering with some computers.
Increased walking speed in shallow water.
Fixed issue where purchased weapon attachments would sometimes disappear.
Text adjustments in Spanish
As always, thank you for you for all of your feedback, your reviews, and your comments in the forums - we'll continue to work on outstanding issues and feedback as we see it :)

Tomorrow we'll be celebrating a little with a compilation of some of the best creator moments we've seen during launch week - and next week we'll be looking to share our update roadmap with you, which will include some new and exciting ways to fight the horror that lurks in the depths...
We'll speak to you all very soon.

topNew: Fixed issue where Headbob was interfering with some computers.
Increased walking speed in shallow water.

items.text: Hey Divers, First off: thank you again for diving into Beneath, playing, streaming, sharing your experiences, and helping us uncover what works - and what doesn’t. As a two‑person studio, we’re deeply committed to making this game as smooth and scary as possible. Below is a breakdown of the main bugs that will be fixed with this patch.
Fixed arms clipping in some animations.
Fixed the issue that allowed gunfire from the running position.
Fixed the issue that allowed gunfire right after closing the inventory, before the weapon was visible.
Fixed a couple of missing collisions.
Fixed the issue where some players were stuck just after meeting Nicole and grabbing the handgun.
Decreased the shadow opacity (so it's not pure black).
Fixed the issue where the safe code wasn't displaying correctly in a computer in Shirazi Station
Tweaks to the soldier AI to prevent shooting when the player is not in sight.
Adjusted the reload speed of Scar, M4 & AK weapons.
Reloading weapons can now happen when sanity is triggered.
The door has been re-opened in Girard when coming back to open the safe.
Extinguishers will no longer already be exploded in Ivanov when meeting Gaggith.
What Else We’re Doing
We’re already working on further patches targeting the other bugs reported.
Visual asset enhancements and optimization work are ongoing; we'll roll out these gradually.
We’re reading all your feedback (forums, reviews, streams) and prioritizing issues based on severity and frequency.
About Micro Stutters

We've had some reports of people playing on 4k resolution monitors with high refresh rates (120hz and above) encountering performance issues. This is something we are looking into and testing across various monitors and configurations to identify the cause. Whilst we look into this, we ask that anyone experiencing these issues please drop a comment in our bug section of steam forums with your GPU, CPU, and type of drive you have Beneath installed on so we can get as many variations confirmed of people encountering this (especially important if you are NOT running 4k or above 60fps) Thank you for your patience whilst we investigate this, we'll be updating you all as soon as we have some conclusive updates!

Your feedback is invaluable. Every bug report, screenshot, clip, review and stream helps us make Beneath better. If you encounter something not listed above, please drop it in our Steam Discussions or share a ticket with specs, reproduction steps, etc. We’re committed to supporting this game long‑term, improving the experience, and making the depths you explore feel immersive, stable and scary.
Thanks for playing, thanks for diving deep, and thanks for helping us fix the rough edges.

releases.displayName: Beneath Demo Update – Your Feedback Matters!

items.text: Over the past few weeks, the demo for Beneath has been live – and we’ve LOVED seeing your reactions to it! Along with your spooky (and sometimes hilarious) gameplay clips, you’ve also given us some awesome feedback on what you’d like to see in the game.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43715895/a2d8a75d5eb82f5a1b9c88e901344fefda593da0.gif"]

notes.title: Here are just a few of the improvements that have been made

items.text: Gameplay & Controls
Aim Down Sights (ADS) is here! Take precision shooting to the next level - because sometimes hip-fire just won’t cut it.
Weapon Sway added for that realistic touch. Keep your aim steady, soldier!
Controller weapon scrolling is now fully functional. Effortlessly cycle through your arsenal without missing a beat.
Reload animation fix: picking up ammo mid-reload no longer resets your slick animation.
Difficulty settings now apply correctly and display handy descriptions when using a controller.
Reset keybinds option added for those who like to make their controls their own (or just pressed “change” one too many times 😅).
You can no longer see your arms flopping around after death - rest easy, they’re taking a well-deserved break.
AI & Balancing
Smarter enemies: fewer grenade spam sessions, more tactical choices.
Gameplay balancing pass - enemy damage and health are now tuned for a smoother challenge curve.
That one zombie that forgot how to move? We gave it a pep talk. It’s back on the prowl and getting closer to you by the second!
Localization & Text Fixes
All languages are now fully implemented! (Previously just English and Chinese.)
Fixed French text that was a little too passionate and overflowed its UI box.
Patched an unsupported Chinese character that was misbehaving.
Settings text and “Back” button are now cleaner, clearer, and easier to click.
Audio & Visual Polish
Sound effects have been improved - crisper shots, deeper thuds, and better overall immersion.
Loading screens now look great at all resolutions - no more chopped-off pictures or text.
General performance boost, especially in areas with tons of realtime lights and physics.

Hardware detection added at startup! The game now automatically adjusts visual and physics settings to match your rig - smarter, faster, smoother. (You can still tweak everything in the main menu if you prefer to fine-tune.)
Bug Fixes & Tweaks
Text and UI adjustments across multiple menus.
A bunch of under-the-hood bug fixes to keep your gameplay silky smooth.

We appreciate every bit of feedback, and we would love it if you could leave our demo a review! Head to the page below to check out the demo if you haven't already, and help us reach the heights of Steam Next Fest!
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3238080/Beneath_Demo"]
